content.body:
The MP34 was considered the "Rolls Royce of submachine guns," and was incredibly expensive to make due to the finest materials being used to manufacture it. It was in service from 1930-1970's and was used by many countries in different conflicts.
This limited smg is available for free players as an introductory weapon. By upgrading to a starter or premium account you will receive access to more weapons and vehicles the game has to offer.
content.brief: WEAPON: Maschinenpistole 34 (MP34) AMMO: 9x19mm Luger Parabellum MAGAZINE: 32 rounds MUZZLE VELOCITY: 410+/- m/s RATE OF FIRE: 600+/- rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: StiG 24 HE Grenades (1) Combat Knife
content.title: Limited Submachine Gunner
